The season started on 1 September 2011 and finished on 13 April 2012. [[Al-Duhail SC|Lekhwiya]] were the defending champions. ==Teams== [[Al-Sailiya SC|Al-Sailiya]] were relegated to the second-level league after finishing bottom in the [[2010–11 Qatar Stars League|last season]] campaign.
